entries.title: Track the Skunk Ape Across Gambit Bay
entries.summary: A repeatable route to one of Leonida's strangest wilderness encounters, including the clue that continues the mystery.
entries.location: The inner peninsula across Gambit Bay from Jason's first house
details: Take Jason's boat from the dock outside his initial home and aim for the dead-end road on the inside edge of the peninsula across the bay.
The encounter announces itself before landing: a prompt asks you to use Focus Mode to follow the noise. Keep reactivating Focus as the creature runs into the mangroves.
The trail ends at a disturbing effigy beside a tree. After the sighting, scan storefronts and telephone poles for Skunk Ape flyers; they connect the encounter to a later mission.
steps: Use Jason's docked boat and cross Gambit Bay toward the peninsula's dead-end road.
When the audio prompt appears, activate Focus Mode and follow the highlighted trail inland.
Inspect the effigy, then look for Skunk Ape flyers around Leonida to continue the chain.

entries.title: Vice City International Aircraft Yard
entries.summary: Reach the commercial aircraft apron and leave with a flyable jet without getting trapped by ground equipment.
entries.location: VCIA, west Vice-Dale County, southwest of central Vice City
details: On the world map, identify the airport by its two large wedge-shaped runways. Commercial aircraft are parked around the terminal and apron.
Reverse away from the stand before turning. Baggage and support vehicles can wedge beneath the wings or landing gear if you try to pivot immediately.
The apron is also a reliable place to discover ground vehicles including the Brute Ripley and HVY Airtug, while the central terminal contains ATMs.
steps: Approach VCIA from the southwest side of the city and locate the aircraft apron.
Choose a parked aircraft and clear its rear path before entering.
Reverse in a straight line, then turn toward the nearest runway for takeoff.

entries.title: Police Trunks Hide Free Tactical Gear
entries.summary: Police vehicles can supply shotguns, assault rifles, armor and ammo if you open the right storage compartment safely.
entries.location: Police stations and parked law-enforcement vehicles in Vice City or Port Gellhorn
details: Police pickup beds can contain unlocked storage crates with weapons, ammunition and occasional Stun Guns. They can be looted without triggering a vehicle alarm.
Cruiser trunks are alarmed. The Slim Jim earned during the Chapter 2 mission Moses unlocks a cruiser door and silently releases its trunk; forcing the trunk earlier triggers the alarm.
Move long guns into your personal vehicle's trunk afterward. Openly carrying them makes you conspicuous and can attract police attention.
steps: Scan the vehicle with WAiNK first to check its alarm and access requirements.
For a cruiser, use the Slim Jim on a door before opening the trunk; for a police pickup, climb into the bed and open its crate.
Transfer valuable gear to your owned personal vehicle instead of carrying every long gun openly.

entries.title: Unlock the Snap Gun and Silent Back Rooms
entries.summary: Use Yasmani's Chapter 3 tool to bypass secured doors and reach alarm controls before committing to a robbery.
entries.location: Yasmani, after the Chapter 3 jewelry heist in Dubious Provenance
details: The Snap Gun opens compatible locked doors but does not automatically neutralize a building alarm. Treat it as a quiet access tool, not a complete stealth solution.
When the lock interface appears, move the left stick until the tension reaches the sweet spot, then hold the right trigger to fill the release meter.
Prioritize staff entrances and back-office doors. Reaching the security office first can let you disable the alarm before kicking doors, smashing cases or confronting employees.
steps: Complete the Chapter 3 jewelry-heist sequence and meet Yasmani during Dubious Provenance.
Equip the Snap Gun at a compatible door and select Use snap gun.
Find the tension sweet spot with the left stick, then hold the right trigger until the lock releases.

entries.title: Break Recognition, Not Just Line of Sight
entries.summary: GTA 6 remembers your clothes and vehicle after the immediate chase. A complete escape therefore needs a second phase.
entries.location: Any escape route with cover, intersections and access to your personal vehicle
details: Police are not shown as simple moving dots on the radar. Read awareness and threat indicators, watch road geometry and use hard corners to make pursuing vehicles overshoot.
After losing direct pursuit, your description may remain active. Police can identify your clothes and car, so continuing in the same vehicle and outfit risks restarting the chase.
Store up to five alternate outfits in your personal vehicle. Pull into cover, change clothes from the trunk and switch vehicles when possible; K9 units can punish a static hiding spot.
steps: Use successive sharp turns, elevation changes and solid cover to break direct awareness.
Stop out of sight, open your personal vehicle trunk and change into a stored outfit.
Leave the identified vehicle behind or alter your route before returning to populated streets.

entries.title: Build a Mission Loadout From Your Trunk
entries.summary: The two-long-gun limit makes preparation more valuable than collecting every weapon on your character.
entries.location: Your owned personal vehicle, before entering a mission or restricted area
details: Only two long guns can be equipped on your back, while oversized melee weapons and reserve equipment live in the personal vehicle trunk.
Match the pair to the objective: a suppressed close-range weapon plus a rifle is flexible; a shotgun plus precision rifle is stronger when stealth has already failed.
Scan unknown vehicles and containers before forcing them. WAiNK can reveal alarm state, while unlocked trunks may provide cash, drugs, consumables or emergency ammunition.
steps: Read the mission environment and decide whether the likely engagement is stealth, interiors or long-range.
Equip only the two appropriate long guns and store the rest in your owned vehicle.
Park outside the immediate threat area so the trunk remains reachable during preparation or retreat.

entries.title: Split Cash, Contraband and Bank Funds
entries.summary: Banking everything is safe but can lock you out of spontaneous paid encounters; carrying everything exposes too much value.
entries.location: Banks, ATMs, Jason's stash and your personal vehicle trunk
details: Keep a modest cash reserve for bribes, pool games and random encounters that require payment in the moment, while depositing the bulk after a profitable job.

Store stolen jewelry, drugs and marked bills in the trunk of an owned personal vehicle. Contraband in an impounded owned car remains recoverable, but goods left in a disposable stolen car can disappear with it.
Before experimenting with risky tactics or cheats, create a separate manual save from Pause > Game > Save so your main progression remains clean.
steps: Deposit most mission proceeds, but retain several hundred dollars for world opportunities.
Move unsold contraband into your owned vehicle instead of an arbitrary stolen car.
Create a new manual save slot before a high-risk robbery or cheat session.

entries.title: Use RydeMe Without Missing Discoveries
entries.summary: Combine fast travel with deliberate scanning so the map fills quickly without skipping the systems that unlock locations and collectibles.
entries.location: Across Vice City and greater Leonida
details: Call a taxi through RydeMe, enter, look toward the driver with L2/LT and hold Triangle/Y to skip the journey. The base fast-travel fee is $100 and rises over longer distances.
Between taxi jumps, scan vehicles by holding D-pad Up at the WAiNK prompt and study animals through binoculars with R1/RB. These actions feed collections instead of merely revealing roads.
Enable collectible and criminal-profile notifications, and use map filters to isolate the activity type you are currently completing.
steps: Choose a distant activity cluster, then call RydeMe and fast-travel to its nearest discovered point.
Survey the surrounding blocks on foot, responding to WAiNK, binocular and conversation prompts.
Check Progress > Collections and clear one category at a time using the matching map filter.

entries.title: Instant Body Armor
entries.summary: Adds body armor to the current loadout after completing its fitness challenge and the main story.
entries.location: Free roam after completing all main story missions
details: Unlock requirement: complete 100 workouts. The Cheats menu only becomes available after Jason and Lucia's main story is complete.
Safety warning: activating any cheat disables saving and Trophies/Achievements for that play session. Use a separate manual save first and restart the game to return to normal progression.
steps: Open the phone with D-pad Up while in free roam.
Hold L1 + R1 on PS5 or LB + RB on Xbox together.
Enter the direction sequence exactly as displayed below.
entries.code: DOWN, UP, LEFT, UP, UP, UP, UP, UP, DOWN, DOWN

entries.title: Refill Maximum Ammunition
entries.summary: Restocks every carried weapon to its maximum capacity after earning the shooting-range requirement.
entries.location: Free roam after completing all main story missions
details: Unlock requirement: earn 25 Bronze medals or better at shooting ranges, then finish the main story to expose the Cheats menu.
This is a one-time refill, not infinite ammunition. Activating it disables saves and Trophies/Achievements for the active session.
steps: Open the phone with D-pad Up while in free roam.
Hold L1 + R1 on PS5 or LB + RB on Xbox together.
Enter the direction sequence, then verify the ammunition counters before starting combat.
entries.code: DOWN, UP, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT, LEFT, UP, UP, DOWN, LEFT

entries.title: Infinite Ammunition
entries.summary: Stops reserve ammunition from running out, while normal magazine reloads still apply.
entries.location: Free roam after completing all main story missions
details: Unlock requirement: earn 25 Silver medals or better at shooting ranges and complete the main story.
Do not confuse this with No Reload: Infinite Ammo preserves reserves, but weapon magazines still cycle. Saves and Trophies/Achievements remain disabled until the session is restarted.
steps: Open the phone with D-pad Up while in free roam.
Hold L1 + R1 on PS5 or LB + RB on Xbox together.
Enter the sequence and test it only in a disposable, unsaved session.
entries.code: DOWN, UP, RIGHT, DOWN, LEFT, LEFT, UP, DOWN, DOWN, DOWN

entries.title: Cycle Leonida's Weather
entries.summary: Rotates through weather states for cinematic exploration, photography and controlled vehicle testing.
entries.location: Free roam after completing all main story missions
details: Unlock requirement: reveal the entire map, then complete the main story so the Cheats menu is available.
Use this for photo sessions or handling comparisons, not a progression save. Like every cheat, it disables saving and Trophies/Achievements for the current session.
steps: Open the phone with D-pad Up while in free roam.
Hold L1 + R1 on PS5 or LB + RB on Xbox together.
Repeat the sequence to step through available weather presets.
entries.code: DOWN, RIGHT, UP, DOWN, RIGHT, UP, RIGHT
